ctaHeading: Ready to Transform Your Mickleham Garden?
aboutText: At Jawanda Projects, we bring over 15 years of landscaping expertise to Mickleham and surrounding areas. Our team, led by Manjit, listens to your vision and budget to create outdoor spaces that reflect your unique needs. From complete landscape redesigns to turf installation and custom decks, we deliver professional results with transparent pricing and reliable project management.
servicesText: We offer a comprehensive range of landscaping services for residential and commercial properties in Mickleham, Altona, and surrounding areas. Our expertise includes everything from initial design to final implementation, ensuring your outdoor space meets your exact specifications.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: We listen to your ideas and create custom designs that transform your outdoor space into a functional and beautiful area.

services.title: Lawn & Turf Installation
services.desc: From seed to instant turf, we install lush, green lawns that are perfect for family use and enhance curb appeal.

services.title: Hardscaping & Paving
services.desc: We design and build durable pathways, patios, and retaining walls using quality materials to suit your landscape.

services.title: Irrigation Systems
services.desc: Efficient irrigation solutions to keep your garden hydrated, saving water and maintaining plant health throughout the seasons.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular maintenance services including pruning, weeding, and fertilising to keep your garden looking its best year-round.

services.title: Outdoor Structures & Decking
services.desc: Custom-built decks, pergolas, and outdoor living areas designed to extend your living space and enjoy the outdoors.
